Record Class MediaLayout.Cell

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.export.MediaLayout.Cell
Record Components:
definition - molecule definition
left - cell left coordinate
top - cell top coordinate
width - cell width in pixels
height - cell height in pixels
modelLeft - model viewport left coordinate
modelTop - model viewport top coordinate
modelWidth - model viewport width in pixels
modelHeight - model viewport height in pixels
imageSize - rendered image size dimension
labels - list of cell text labels
Enclosing class:
MediaLayout
public static record MediaLayout.Cell(MoleculeDef definition, int left, int top, int width, int height, int modelLeft, int modelTop, int modelWidth, int modelHeight, int imageSize, List<MediaLayout.Label> labels) extends Record
Represents a single layout cell within a gallery grid.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
